NAME: Tuto
LINE: Oh no! The key to the lantern tower is gone!

NAME: Rial
LINE: Have you checked your pockets? All twelve of them?

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Of course I checked my pockets!

NAME: Rial
LINE: Then I guess it grew legs and walked off. Happens to the best of us.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Without that key we cannot reach the top of the hill.

NAME: Rial
LINE: Fine. I saw a crow carrying something shiny toward the old well.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Rial! Why did you not say so sooner?
